recipes.name: Seasoned dried anchovies (Myeolchi-muchim)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon rice syrup or corn syrup
instructions: Combine hot pepper flakes, soy sauce, vinegar, rice syrup, garlic, green onion, sesame seeds, and 2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil in a mixing bowl. Mix well with a spoon.
Add the dried anchovies and mix well. Transfer to a serving plate or bowl. Sprinkle some chopped green onion over top and add 1 teaspoon of toasted sesame oil.
Serve as a side dish for rice or with beer.
